## Coverage data
```{r}
reference_coverage_by_pool <- reference_coverage_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("coverage_"),
    names_to = "depth_threshold",
    names_prefix = "coverage_",
    values_to = "genome_coverage_percent"
  ) %>%
  group_by(pool_level, depth_threshold) %>%
  summarise(
    median_percent = median(genome_coverage_percent),
    minimum_percent = min(genome_coverage_percent),
    maximum_percent = max(genome_coverage_percent),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

reference_coverage_by_pool %>% favorite_kable()
```

```{r}
  summarise(
    assemblies = n(),
    typed_assemblies = sum(!is.na(ST) & ST != "-"),

  ) %>% favorite_kable()
```


# Resistance genotype analyes
## Genotype detection
```{r}
detected_amrsearch_genotypes <- amrsearch_gene_data %>%
  filter(isolate %in% isolates) %>%
  distinct(genotype_name, entry) %>%
  arrange(entry, genotype_name)

detected_amrsearch_genotypes_count <- amrsearch_gene_data %>%
  filter(isolate %in% isolates) %>% group_by(genotype_name,entry) %>% summarise(n=n() , percent = n/length(isolates)*100) 

# Genes
paste0("Gene detections")
detected_amrsearch_genotypes_count %>% subset(entry == "gene") %>% arrange(-n) %>% favorite_kable()

# Variants
paste0("Variant detections")
detected_amrsearch_genotypes_count %>% subset(entry == "variant")  %>% arrange(-n) %>% favorite_kable()
```


## Contig distance data
```{r}
paste0("Contig size: ")
fivenum(amrsearch_contig_data$length,na.rm = T) %>% `names<-`(c("min",'lower-hinge','median','upper-hinge',"max"))
paste0("Contig distance from barrier: ")
add_contig_barrier <-  function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      dist_from_start = contig_start - 1,
      dist_from_end = length - contig_stop,
      min_dist_to_edge = pmin(dist_from_start, dist_from_end)
    )
}
amrsearch_contig_data <- add_contig_barrier(amrsearch_contig_data)

fivenum(amrsearch_contig_data$min_dist_to_edge,na.rm = T) %>% `names<-`(c("min",'lower-hinge','median','upper-hinge',"max"))
```

# Coverage data
```{r}
locus_position_coverage <- coverage_qc %>%
  group_by(locus, locus_position) %>%
  summarise(
    isolates_with_coverage = sum(depth > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

locus_coverage_summary <- locus_position_coverage %>%
  summarise(
    loci = n_distinct(locus),
    locus_positions = n(),
    positions_with_coverage = sum(isolates_with_coverage > 0),
    positions_with_coverage_percent = 100 * mean(isolates_with_coverage > 0)
  )

mutation_position_coverage <- mutation_positions %>%
  left_join(
    locus_position_coverage,
    by = c("locus", "locus_position")
  )

mutation_isolate_coverage <- coverage_qc %>%
  inner_join(
    mutation_positions,
    by = c("locus", "locus_position"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

mutation_coverage_summary <- mutation_position_coverage %>%
  summarise(
    database_positions = n(),
    positions_covered_in_at_least_one_isolate = sum(isolates_with_coverage > 0),
    positions_covered_in_all_isolates = sum(isolates_with_coverage == length(isolates))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    isolate_position_observations = nrow(mutation_isolate_coverage),
    isolate_position_observations_with_coverage = sum(
      mutation_isolate_coverage$depth > 0
    ),
    isolate_position_observations_with_coverage_percent =
      100 * mean(mutation_isolate_coverage$depth > 0)
  )

called_locus_coverage_20x <- coverage_breadth_data %>%
  filter(depth_threshold == 20) %>%
  semi_join(gene_calls, by = c("isolate", "locus")) %>%
  summarise(
    isolate_locus_pairs_at_least_90_percent = sum(percent_coverage >= 90),
    called_isolate_locus_pairs = n(),
    percent_at_least_90_percent = 100 * mean(percent_coverage >= 90)
  )


paste0("Mutations in database with coverage in our isolates")
mutation_coverage_summary %>% favorite_kable()

paste0("Isolate locus pairs with coverage over 20X breadth: ")
called_locus_coverage_20x %>% favorite_kable()
```
